description: Uformer encoder-decoder reconstruction diagnostic: one small synthetic fitting control to establish whether the actual network can learn to reconstruct its input under a clearly specified configuration and budget.

global_limits.note: RSS limit: min(4 GiB, 50% of available physical RAM at launch)

cpu_config.note: Fixed CPU thread counts for determinism

u_check.description: Training-pipeline control: 1x1 Conv2d, one input/output channel, with bias

note_bottleneck: all-stride-1: latent [64, 32, 32], element ratio 64:1 expansion, weak spatial compression; shift_flag true: SW-MSA alternates with W-MSA; num_heads 2, win_size 8 (author default), qkv_bias true, mlp_ratio 4.0, LeFF hidden 4*dim; core_layers 3, core_depth 2 (six BasicUformer blocks total, 3+3); ResNet sampling layers with BatchNorm/ReLU, Tanh head; NO global shortcut, NO encoder-decoder skip; 32x32 is square and divisible by win_size 8; initialization: Linear/LayerNorm per upstream Uformer._init_weights; token layout: row-major [B, h*w, C]; BatchNorm train/eval difference is EXPECTED; a deterministic run, stochastic regularization (dropout, attention_drop, drop_path) all ZERO
